notes.title: We have now moved to Full Release
notes.content:
We are so excited to finally bring you the full release version of Four Kings One War. Please enjoy this free to play game and  if you do please help us to continue to develop more and more features by purchasing our supporter skins.  We have so much more to go with this amazing game however if you are looking for deep deep strategy then you don't get any deeper (yet pure) than this.
Currently we are looking for strategists who really have the skills to show case what you can do with the strategy afforded in this game.  If you feel you are equipped then please join us on Discord and reach out to the Wizard who is taking on any challenges in search for the prodigy strategists out there.   Take on the Wizard, Beat the Wizard and get status promotion where you can join the other top strategists at the Four Kings One War round table.

notes.title: Base game is now FREE and supporter packs are live
notes.content:
With over 1.2 million activation's on our recent giveaway we have decided to just make our base game free for life.  For us its all about ensuring this great game continues to develop not only with new and great strategists coming through but also with continued evolution in our user experience.  We have such an amazing vision for this game and our early access version is just the start.  We hope you enjoy the free base game and if you want to help support our future development then we are really excited to announce that our first ever supporter packs are now available here: https://fourkingsonewar.com/supporter-pack-options
These are full of cool stuff like early concept art, historical posters, sound clips, future in game rewards and much much more.  Grab yours today and thank-you so much for your support.  All proceeds will be going back into further development of this amazing game.

notes.title: 375 down loads in under 24 hours
notes.content:
Well here we go!!  We finally got our Free (limited access) demo download available and we have had 375 down loads in under 24 hours.  Given that this is our first ever game released on Steam not 100% sure how this stacks up next to other games or the average but we are pretty excited about it!!

If you are keen to try the game, play the AI up to level hard or even try it in virtual reality then download the free demo.

Just remember though that if you find that you are in fact a natural strategist and able to give the AI a run for its money, if you would like to play another human and start to get a ranking then you will need to purchase the full version.

The AI throughout all its levels has pretty much most of the strategy learned over the 18 years put into it (give or take) but there is so much more strategy to be discovered.  Four Kings One War combat arena is unchartered and is awaiting new strategist to make their mark.  This could easily be you as with this game there is not 1400 years of other peoples strategy to learn first before you have a shot at the top so you don't have to have locked yourself in your basement for years to make your mark.

The beauty of chess strategy for us, does not lay in the 8 X 8 chess boar, it lays in the way the pieces move and compliment each other (pure strategy) which is why we have not messed with the DNA of the game but instead, tried to bring the strategy into the 21st century.  What we do know from years of play testing is, if you think of yourself as a modern day strategist then more than likely you are going to love this game.

Great news is, now you can try it for free. 

This is a community in the making and you are all the pioneers to this, the first brave warriors to take it on.  We at Four Kings One War salute you!!

notes.title: Four Kings One War Free Demo now live
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 
We have now set our FREE demo live so if you want to try before you buy then we are excited to be able to now offer you access to this amazing game via our FREE demo version.

This will give you access to the AI at levels 
Easy, Medium and Hard and is available on PC / Mac as well as Virtual reality.

Just to point out, the Free Demo will give you access to only one environment which is the stunning glow worm cave and you also will not be able to play against another human. You will only be able to play the AI (The mighty Morpheus) 

If you would like to play another human or get access to the other amazing environments then you will need to purchase the full game.

We really hope you enjoy the incredible strategy that this game allows and hope to see you in the public arena as soon as possible.

notes.title: Four Kings One War Virtual Reality is now live!!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,  
We are super excited to announce that the Virtual Reality add on (DLC) is now live and available for HTC Vive and Oculus.
check out the 4 different environments all set in a native New Zealand bush.

The Glow worm cave: Spectacular New Zealand glow worm where you can hone your skills against the mighty AI

The Bush environment: Play on a board the size of a house where the pieces are the size of an average person while being surrounded by a beautiful New Zealand native bush scene.

The waterfall: Set deep in a native New Zealand bush.  Listen to the amazing sounds of native birds and running waterfall while you concentrate on the battle at hand.

The abyss: Set in an underground hall with flames setting the atmosphere while you take on your opponent.

If you have ever wondered what it is like to visit a New Zealand native bush well now you can with spectacular graphics and a truly amazing strategic challenge.  

Enjoy!!!
